svg.text: A bigger model and gentler augmentation did not improve window and door counts: the labels set the ceiling
History of the detector training for raster floor plans, 14 Nov 2026 (local time). The score is the number of questions answered with exactly the right count per drawing.

Runs 4–6 are scored on the 480 dev drawings: other drawings, not comparable with runs 1–3
Learning curves: validation mAP50-95 after each epoch
Higher is better, on the 239 validation drawings. Each run averages over its own classes
(run 1: 13, run 3: 6, the others: 7), so heights compare only among runs 2, 4, 5 and 6.
What came out, per symbol kind
Bar: share of the questions of that kind answered with exactly the right count; the figure is that count. The two panels use different
drawings: compare within a panel, never across.
Source: Ultralytics results.csv and the exact-count report of each run (docs/training-data). Thresholds are tuned on the validation drawings.
